title: Spike: Product Intent
purpose: Clarify what this product is trying to do and who it serves.

questions.label: Primary Goal
questions.prompt: In one sentence, what is the single most important thing this product must do?

questions.label: Primary User
questions.prompt: Who is the primary user of this system?

questions.label: Success Definition
questions.prompt: How will you know the product is successful? What measurable outcome changes?
